I have now gathered sufficient information regarding your fever, altered mental status, muscle rigidity, and haloperidol use to make a definitive diagnosis. The clinical picture of severe rigidity, autonomic instability (sweating, fever), and confusion in a patient on antipsychotics is classic for NMS.
